generator.program.note: The cushion azorellas' own program (growth plan G2.3a), renamed from `cushion` and homed here: a dome packed with rosettes, after the llareta (A. compacta).

traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Azorella (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.42 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 2 records in 2 sources); trunks 0.41, branches 0.42. A species with its own measurements states its own. Basic density is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.life_span.note: Reiche, Flora de Chile vol. 3 (about 1902), Umbelliferae, pp. 62-79: the three genera now merged into Azorella that hold the library's species, Laretia (A. compacta, as Laretia compacta), Azorella and Mulinum (A. prolifera, as M. spinosum), are each described as perennial herbs; Gay (1847) and Weddell (1857) call Mulinum half-shrubby.
